import.fromFile: Import from Excel, Sheets, CSV or Notion
import.fileHelp: Choose an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file. From Google Sheets use File > Download; from Notion export the table as CSV. First row must be column names. Useful columns: name, parent phone, phone, parent name, class, batch, monthly fee, fee cycle, due day. Only name and parent phone are required.
